title: Book of Enoch cut from the Tanakh

tellings.quote: backstory here. And you find the backstory preserved in the book of Enoch, which was first discovered in Ethiopia. And he clearly was at one point part of the Tanakh and was excised,

plain: The philosopher Jason Jorjani tells Michels that the Book of Enoch, an ancient Jewish text "first discovered in Ethiopia," was "at one point part of the Tanakh," the Hebrew Bible, "and was excised," and that it preserves the backstory to the biblical story he is discussing. He points to R. H. Charles's English translation of Enoch, published in 1917, and the King James Bible of 1611. Those texts show what each collection contains as published, but whether Enoch once stood inside the Hebrew canon and was removed is a question they leave open.
